pkgmetadata.longdescription: A native YouTube Music desktop client focused on low overhead: it uses libmpv for playback and its own OpenGL UI instead of a web view, with real crossfade, caching, playlists and party mode.

use.flag: Use WebKitGTK for the in-app Google/Spotify sign-in popup. Without it, sign-in falls back to importing request headers from a browser.
